notes: Seed catalog for notification-service v1.1 (WhatsApp + template_history).
Each entry corresponds to one row of notification.templates.
Locales = [en, ar] (2). Names below exercise the trip/food/payment/safety/marketing categories plus loyalty/merchant/courier/driver/incentive/support for breadth.
Total = 8 names x 5 channels x 2 locales = 80 templates.
WhatsApp entries use template_type='whatsapp_structured' and carry a structured body with header/body/footer/buttons + numbered variables — see WHATSAPP_TEMPLATES.md for the full schema.
Non-WhatsApp entries use template_type='plain' and a Handlebars body.
Provider template id + approval status are null for all entries; in production these are filled in by the WhatsApp approval workflow (admin POST /v1/admin/templates/{id}/submit-for-approval).

All templates use the polymorphic request_id + service pattern: trip.* templates receive request_id (the trip_id) with service='trip'; food.order.* templates receive request_id (the order_id) with service='food_order'.
Deeplinks are conditional via {{#if}} helpers: trip templates produce uber://trip/{{request_id}} when service='trip', food templates produce uber://orders/{{request_id}} when service='food_order'.
